description: Fetch one URL (page or PDF) as clean markdown with route diagnostics. query returns only the top_k passages that answer it. content_scope="full" returns the whole page text, not just the main content. force_browser renders it in a browser (3 credits instead of 1); render="auto" does that only for a JavaScript shell. Returns data.title, data.content_markdown, data.published_at/modified_at when the page gives them, data.fetched_at and content_status (ok, thin, blocked, needs_javascript, not_found); fields: https://clawifi.dev/docs/fetch.
name: fetch_url
title: Fetch a page
